description.value:
Traits Signal

Your Encore cap increases by 1, on top of the level-based caps. Every effect that refers to your cap uses the increased value. Note that this makes Crescendo more expensive as well as more powerful: Crescendo still requires only 5 Encore, but it always spends your entire pool, so a larger cap means a larger pool spent.

cinderfall.incomplete: SB1 — would be a one-line `SpecialResource.max` bump (P1) if the resource existed. No SpecialResource rule element exists for Encore, this class's own resource (defined only in prose in classes.the-signal.json's terms flag). SpecialResource can model a permanent resource pool (renew: false) per pf2e-source, so this is a real gap, not a schema limitation, but nothing in the corpus fills it -- no companion class-feature/ability/effect card holds it either.
